notes.title: Optimized Update [1/12/2024]
notes.notes:
Optimized content:

1.The difficulty of Chapter 1 is reduced
2. Enhance reminders when energy points are insufficient
3. Add a prompt when the crystal is enough to be strengthened.
4. The movement operation is selected by default when the hero goes into battle.

notes.title: Game Release Date [January 09th]!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am very happy to announce that "Dragon Lair Depths" will be released to everyone on January 09th, which is five days later.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44090356/0ec56c824ff5d809fa765f6e1478d5feb63461ef.jpg[/img]

With the concerted efforts and cooperation of the three of us in our small studio, after nearly a year of development, we finally waited for the day to be released. "Dragon Lair Depths" is also the second work we have developed after "Dark Box".

"Dragon Lair Depths" is a short board turn-based strategy game. You need to understand the enemy's skills and behavior, use limited action points and the cooperation between heroes to defeat the enemy and protect the Earth Vein.

On January 09th, we invite you to go deep into the dragon's lair and outsmart the dragon!

-Atomheart Game Studio

notes.title: Demo Trial Version Update _ English Language!
notes.notes:
[b]This update includes:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Increase English language.
[*] Remove crystal consumption for energy acquisition events.
[*] Add the function of unloading relics.
[*] Add a combat damage system: if a hero dies in battle, maximum health -1, and if the maximum health reaches 0, the hero dies permanently.
[*] Increase resolution, language switch, and sound settings.
[/olist]

If you enjoy our game, please [u]add it to your wishlist[/u]!
Feel free to provide any feedback or suggestions in the community!"

notes.title: Demo Trial Version Update!
notes.notes:
[u][b]This update includes:[/b][/u]
1.Added [u]English language[/u].
2.Added several new relics.
3.Redesigned the skills of the Aquatic Warrior.
4.Added enemy spawn indicators.
5.Reduced the difficulty of the boss in the first chapter.
6.Decreased the cost of removing characters from the team from 3 points to 2 points.
7.Improved gameplay and performance.
8.Added basic tutorials.

If you enjoy our game, please [u]add it to your wishlist[/u]!
Feel free to provide any feedback or suggestions in the community!
